intro.title: Choose your home or investment with confidence
intro.paragraph1: Luxe Home Estate brings together apartments, villas, houses, land, offices and commercial property for buyers, tenants and owners searching in Baku. Listings can be explored by sale or rent, property type, city and district, price, area and other important criteria. Available price, location, area, room, document and renovation details make it easier to compare options before deciding.
intro.paragraph2: Start with ready-made searches, review suitable residential developments and contact our team directly about any property that interests you. We do not display artificial offers when there are no real active listings; new properties appear on the relevant category and location pages as they are published. Our goal is to make finding a suitable option simple, transparent and convenient.

about.description: {legalName} provides real estate sales, rentals, mortgages, renovation and construction, advertising and photography services.
about.paragraph1: Our approach is simple: understand the client's real needs and find the right property. We treat every enquiry individually, taking budget, area, lifestyle and future plans into account.
about.paragraph2: We value transparency at every stage of the transaction. Information about the property's condition, documents and terms is presented as it is.
about.paragraph3: Our team focuses on building long-term relationships, not only completing sales. Every satisfied client is our greatest achievement.
